HOW IT WORKS

How a pick gets posted.

No hunches and no favorite players. A pick posts only when the numbers say the price is good.

We price every prop

Lines from the big licensed US sportsbooks for every posted NFL and NBA player prop, rechecked every 10 minutes, every day of the week.

Only real edges qualify

A pick locks the moment a DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM, Caesars or Fanatics price beats the sportsbooks’ consensus by at least 1%, with three or more books pricing both sides.

Locked, then graded

Each pick is timestamped before kickoff and graded from box scores. Nothing gets deleted, and the losses stay up too.
